description.value: Greta YVR is an adults-only arcade bar in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood, combining craft cocktails, scratch-made locally sourced street food, and 50+ arcade games under one roof. It is part of a Canadian multi-city chain and offers a lively venue for small groups, large parties, and corporate events. Cyclists of legal drinking age stopping in Gastown for an evening out would find food, drinks, and entertainment all in one place.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 87m; stands (4 spaces) at 87m; stands (6 spaces) at 89m; stands (4 spaces) at 90m; stands (6 spaces) at 96m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the business is an active arcade bar at 50 W Cordova St, Vancouver, with phone 1-604-423-3081 matching OSM. The website explicitly states 'Takeout & Delivery Available' and describes a scratch-made, locally sourced street food menu. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag suggests the venue opens at 15:00 (3 pm) daily including Monday, but the website states hours begin at 4 pm and the venue is closed on Mondays — OSM hours appear outdated.
Adults-only venue: website states 'Guests must be of legal drinking age to enter,' which limits the audience.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active food-and-drink establishment in Gastown with takeout available; a reasonable evening stop for adult touring cyclists exploring downtown Vancouver.

wow_evidence: part of a Canadian multi-city chain
